# Sideways text-layer fixtures

Generated text-only PDFs containing the synthetic phrase `First second third`.
The line's known upright bounds are `[300,300,550,316]` in a 700×700 page.
The text is rotated around `[300,300]` by 90° and 270° counterclockwise.
These exercise word/sentence extraction from a corrected fpdf2 OCR text layer;
they contain no source scans. The embedded subset of Noto Sans uses SIL OFL 1.1.
